summary.objective_summary: Applicant.__post_init__ in demo-repo/src/loanflow/applicants.py now rejects any years_employed that is not a plain int (float 2.5, bool True/False) with ValidationError, placed before the unchanged negative check. It uses the repository idiom isinstance(x, bool) or not isinstance(x, int), following the precedent of vault run summary run-20261001-obsidianlive-002 and vault note LFCONV-INTGUARD-01, both corroborated by the repository (findings F-8/F-9). Regression test test_applicant_rejects_non_integer_and_bool_years_employed was added to demo-repo/tests/unit/test_applicants.py (+2/+9 lines, TDD: C-1 failed as expected, C-2 passed). The Quality Engineer's V-1 (7 passed) confirmed AC-1, AC-2 and AC-4 but marked AC-3 blocked: its Discovery-authored clause 'the default 0 constructs successfully' is exercised by no test in demo-repo. final_verdict is therefore inconclusive. The orchestrator independently re-ran ORCH-1 (7 passed) and ORCH-2 (107 unit tests passed) through the test-runner Skill with matching command identity.
lessons_learned_appended: In Discovery, every clause of every acceptance criterion must map to a test that already exists or that scope explicitly tells the Engineer to add. A 'behavior unchanged' AC that bundles in a clause no test exercises (e.g. 'the default value constructs successfully') makes the Quality Engineer correctly mark that AC blocked and return inconclusive. The code can be correct and the full suite green, yet the run cannot pass. A promoted scope.json cannot be amended mid-run, and an inconclusive verdict is not route-back eligible.
remaining_risks: AC-3's default-value clause (Applicant constructed without years_employed yields 0) is unverified by any test, so this run cannot be called a pass even though the full unit suite is green.
Per-agent cost is unpriced for all three subagents and orchestrator usage is not measured in-session, so full_pipeline_total is null.
follow_up_actions: Start a new /work run (new run_id) that adds a default-years_employed test in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_applicants.py, or re-scope AC-3 without the default-0 clause.
